tools.name: find_suburb
tools.description: Finds Sydney suburbs by name, spelled as find_homes takes them in profile.about.suburbs.

tools.name: find_school
tools.description: Finds NSW public schools that have an intake zone, by name, with the four-digit codes find_homes takes in profile.schools.zoneSchools.

tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Finds a place in Sydney a buyer travels to, such as a hospital, university or station, with the position find_homes takes in profile.commute. Answers from Sagashi's own list of places.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "home_details" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
